Head lamp.function_of_item:
Your Plant :
Headlamp assembly in specific design (bulb/LED assembly, lens fitting, aiming, electrical connection)

Ship to Plant : 

End User : 
1. Provide adequate illumination of the road ahead during low-light or night conditions
2. Ensure visibility of the vehicle to other road users
3. Meet legal/regulatory lighting requirements (beam pattern, intensity, color)
Head lamp.function_of_work_element:
1. Man: 
1. COLLECT THE HEAD LAMP LH / RH SIDE FROM STORAGE AREA AND SCAN THE PART
2. CONNECT THE 2 CONNECTORS WITH HEAD LAMP
3. ALIGN THE HEAD LAMP WITH THE BIW AND THEN TIGHT WITH BOLTS

2. Machine:
Proper torquing with 6NM

3. Material (Indirect) :
Hand Gloves, Apron

4. Method:
1. Install Head lamp from sequencing trolley and scan
2. Align H/L with BIW, then do the connections with wiring harness with head lamp and tight with bolts
Head lamp.failure_effect:
Your Plant:
1. Wrong Head lamp variant installed
2. FURTHER OPERATION NOT POSSIBLE
3. Lens cracked or broken

Ship to Plant : Nil

End User:
1. Headlamp does not turn ON
2. Insufficient brightness / dim light
3. Customer dissatisfaction

Grill fitment-High.function_of_item:
Your Plant :
To correctly install front grill fitment as per BIW design specifications.

Ship to Plant : 

End User : 
1. Allow airflow to the radiator, condenser, and engine compartment
2. Protect cooling components from debris, stones, insects
3. Provide vehicle styling and brand identity
Grill fitment-High.function_of_work_element:
1. Man: 
1. TAKE THE FRONT GRILL FROM THE STORAGE AREA AND SCAN THE PART
2. CONNECT THE CONNECTORS WITH GRILL
3. INSERT & 
ALIGN THE FRONT GRILL WITH BIW AND THEN TIGHT WITH BOLTS AND PUSHPINS

2. Machine:
Proper torquing with 4NM

3. Material (Indirect) :
Hand Gloves, Apron

4. Method:
1. Install Front grill from sequencing trolley and scan
2. Then do the connections with wiring harness with grill and align with BIW and tight with bolts & pushpins
Grill fitment-High.failure_effect:
Your Plant:
1. Wrong front grill variant installed
2. FURTHER OPERATION NOT POSSIBLE
3. Gaps or scratches on grill 

Ship to Plant : Nil

End User:

3. Customer dissatisfaction
